As part of this work, we have evaluated the feasibility of integrating the RFUS technology with manufacturing three major packaging grades, namely linerboard, corrugating medium and bleached board. The RFUS technology can be integrated as a retrofit in existing paper machines with cylinder drying or as part of a new paper machine. Assuming most of the energy consumed in the dryer section is to evaporate the water removed, the reduction in operating costs associated with the decreases in energy consumption were estimated to be 11% to 37% for the various grades studied. 4 DE-EE0009395 The RFUS technology developed here upon extensive further verification and pilot-scale evaluation and detailed engineering feasibility analysis can be potentially considered for commercial implementation. This technology and the relevant equipment and drying system can be potentially considered in commercial manufacturing of paper, consumer products, biomaterials, food, and other industries in the U.S. The customers for the RFUS equipment/technology would be the paper and board manufacturers in the US and around the world. The target market can extend beyond commodity paper manufacturing to specialty papers, paperboard, and other bio-based materials. 5 DE-EE0009395 List of Figures Figure 1.
